about_the_game:
Yin.Story is a ​non-linear story editor designed for creators to craft multi-branched interactive stories, visual novels, or cinematic games. With an intuitive tree-based visual editor, real-time hot reloading, and cross-platform compatibility, it empowers you to "weave intricate story threads" effortlessly. Players can explore your creations seamlessly via web browsers or ​Steam Workshop integration.

​Key Features

Visual Editor
Build story structures using mind-map-like tree diagrams, where connections define branching paths, making complex narratives visually clear.

Hot Reload
Every edit is instantly reflected in the running story, eliminating downtime and ensuring smooth iteration.

Script Support
Embed dynamic logic using scripts, with data handled through ​Yin.Ióobject for object-oriented design and hot-syncing.

Server Mode
Run the client in server mode, allowing access from any device for ​**[Remote Play]**.

Cross-Device Support
Stories load via web browsers (optimized for mobile) and native clients.

Multi-User Accounts
Invite friends to experience your stories with isolated accounts, preventing save file conflicts.

Controller-Friendly
Full controller support for both desktop and web versions, ideal for immersive big-screen experiences.

​Supported Scenes

  • ​Basic Scenes: Play videos, images, or audio.

  • ​Text Scenes: Scrollable text narratives.

  • ​Communication Scenes: Simulate social app chat interfaces.

  • ​Dialogue Scenes: Classic visual novel-style text bubbles.

  • ​Scene Groups: Combine multiple scenes (excluding nested groups).

​Roadmap

MacOS and Linux versions are currently in development.
